description:
Several ignored gf2-coding tests carry no reason or a prefix outside the tier vocabulary of `AGENTS.md` (`slow:` and `sim:`), so the nightly tiers cannot classify them.

## Background

Found while aligning the DVB-T2 conformance tests: `external:` reasons in `tests/verify_cached_generator.rs`, `bench:` reasons in `tests/ira_encoder_correctness.rs` and `tests/ldpc_cache_io.rs`, and bare `#[ignore]` attributes in `tests/nr5g_regression.rs`, `src/ldpc/core.rs` and `src/bcjr/mod.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every `#[ignore]` attribute under `crates/gf2-coding/` carries a descriptive reason whose prefix is in the tier vocabulary of `AGENTS.md`, or the test self-gates on required host data or benchmark mode as `AGENTS.md` describes.
- [hard] REQ-02: No test's assertions change, and the Rust CI gate passes.
title: Give every ignored gf2-coding test a tier-vocabulary ignore reason
